definitions.explanation: For something wet to become dry. Intransitive verb used for laundry, surfaces, etc.
When used with {喉|のど} (throat), means to be thirsty: {喉|のど}が{乾|かわ}いた.

examples.japanese: {洗濯物|せんたくもの}が{乾|かわ}きました。
{喉|のど}が{乾|かわ}いています。
ペンキがまだ{乾|かわ}いていません。

notes: {乾|かわ}く is intransitive (something dries on its own). The transitive pair is {乾|かわ}かす (to dry something). {喉|のど}が{乾|かわ}く is the standard way to express thirst, similar to お{腹|なか}が{空|す}く for hunger.
